metadata.module: Foundational Deep Learning Experiments & Optimizer Comparison
metadata.purpose: Academic analysis of optimization dynamics, gradient backpropagation, and generalization.
metadata.disclaimer: Synthetic pedagogical benchmark module for Deep Learning study. Strictly independent from the clinical ISBI 2016 dermoscopy triage ResNet-18 and U-Net models.

bgd.name: Batch Gradient Descent (BGD)
bgd.description: Full dataset evaluation. Exact empirical gradient with zero stochastic variance.

sgd.name: Mini-batch SGD (B=32)
sgd.description: Small batch stochastic updates. High variance gradient trajectory aiding local minimum escape.

momentum.name: Polyak Momentum (γ=0.9)
momentum.description: Velocity accumulation along consistent gradient directions; dampens ravines.

nag.name: Nesterov Accelerated Gradient (NAG)
nag.description: Look-ahead gradient evaluation acting as a predictive brake to suppress momentum overshoot.

lr_high.label: High (η=0.80)
lr_high.behavior: Aggressive initial descent with gradient oscillations

zeros.name: Zero Initialization
zeros.note: Weights and biases set to 0. Symmetry breaking fails across hidden units; hidden units receive identical gradients.

random_normal.name: Random Normal (σ=0.5)
random_normal.note: Gaussian sampling with standard variance. Breaks symmetry, but variance is unscaled by layer fan-in.

xavier_uniform.name: Xavier / Glorot Uniform
xavier_uniform.note: Variance scaled by 2 / (fan_in + fan_out). Designed to preserve activation variance across linear layers.

he_normal.name: He / Kaiming Normal
he_normal.note: Variance scaled by 2 / fan_in specifically for ReLU non-linearities, countering dead activation collapse.

unregularized.name: Unregularized (Weight Decay = 0.0)
unregularized.description: Model overfits small sample noise. Training loss falls near zero while validation loss diverges.

l2_regularized.name: L2 Regularized (Weight Decay = 0.04)
l2_regularized.description: L2 penalty (lambda/2 * ||W||^2) constrains weight magnitude, narrowing the generalization gap.
